officialText:
Section 406.2 – Revise the opening paragraph in Section 406.2 to read as follows:

406.2 Definitions. The definitions in this section shall apply only within this article.

Section 406.2. Revise the definition of “Child Care Facility” in Section 406.2 to read as follows:

Child Care Facility. A building or structure, or portion thereof, for educational, supervisory, or personal care services for more than 2 children 7 years old or less.
